children: was upgraded to Buy equivalent at Morgan Stanley due to greater signs of demand stabilization.

"Physical occupancy is seasonally the highest in Q4 given the build during the holiday season and seasonally lowest in Q2 as holiday inventories are fully drawn down and the summer harvest season has not yet begun. After a -320bps Y/Y decline in Q2 2024 and a -330bps Y/Y decline in Q2 2025, we saw a positive inflection point to +50bps Y/Y in Q2 2026," said analyst Ronald Kamdem.

"USDA cold-storage inventory declined 0.3% Y/Y in July, turning slightly negative after three consecutive positive Y/Y readings. M/M seasonality was in line with the 10-year historical average, suggesting inventory levels may be stabilizing," said the research note.
Furthermore, three key industry headwinds—inventory destocking, new supply deliveries, and trade volatility—are easing, according to the note.
The stock was raised to Overweight from Equal Weight, with the price target set at $47.00.
